input.question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?
input.ground_truth: Already, or mostly already. Look up RepRap. _URL_0_ I saw it in action a few years ago, and assume they've made headway. I think it will be a while before we see printed motors and such, but the majority of parts are simple.

Question: How long until 3D printers can print out 3D printers?

Okay! Imagine you have a special toy machine called a "3D printer." This machine can make lots of different things, like toys, cups, or even parts for other machines.

Now, the question is: "How long until 3D printers can print out another 3D printer?"

Here’s a simple way to think about it:

Right now, 3D printers can already print some parts of another 3D printer! But, the whole 3D printer is a bit tricky because it has tiny, special parts and some parts are made from things that a regular 3D printer can’t use yet (like metal or special plastics).

So, almost right now, a 3D printer can help make *some* parts of another 3D printer. But to make a *whole* new 3D printer by itself, we need to wait a little longer—maybe a few more years—until the printers are even smarter and can use more kinds of materials.

So, soon, maybe in a few years, 3D printers will be able to print out another 3D printer all by themselves! But not quite yet. It’s like when you build a big LEGO set with your little brother’s help, but one day you might be able to build it all by yourself.
